# Machines & Cloud

> Machines & Cloud provides an AI website front desk for home-service shops. Verify your email, save your business answers, review the rules and test privately before activating eligible website chat. The workspace includes requests, conversations, owner-maintained availability and CSV download for manual handoff; native import compatibility needs checking. Setup is free, with no card, subscription or timed trial. Two future service preferences: Coverage $99/month (planning allowance: 150 call minutes and 500 outgoing application texts) and Follow-through $249/month (600 minutes and 1,500 outgoing application texts). Planning overage rates remain $0.35/call minute and $0.03/outgoing application text; application texts are not carrier segments and these estimates are not invoices. Final paid terms require separate agreement. Pro is not offered for new setup. Selecting a preference does not enable billing, phone, SMS, follow-up delivery, calendar, Jobber or Housecall Pro connections. Phone/SMS require separate authorization and delivery verification. Website AI has daily limits; requests and urgent items require owner review. English plumbing microphone practice and typed English/Spanish examples illustrate owner requests without creating visits or sending messages.
